title: Trajectory-Calibrated Merging of Embodied Policies
title_zh: 具身策略的轨迹校准合并
abstract_en: Robot foundation models are increasingly adapted into task specialists to expand their embodied capabilities. Yet these capabilities remain fragmented across separate policies, and existing model-merging methods do not reliably preserve them during closed-loop execution: parameter-space alignment provides only an indirect proxy for behavior, while regression may fail to preserve behavior at states not covered by its calibration inputs. We present Trajectory-Calibrated Regression (TCR), an execution-aware, gradient-free framework that consolidates robot specialists into a single policy. Across two complementary timescales, TCR collects calibration inputs from expert rollouts spanning different stages of task execution and from intermediate states within iterative action generation. To account for representation shifts introduced by merging, TCR recomputes each block's input through the already merged blocks. It then uses each expert's computation within the block to form module inputs and fits merged weights to match the experts' linear outputs. A two-pass calibration procedure further refines the merged policy using separate rollout caches while retaining the frozen specialists as teachers. The resulting model preserves the original inference graph and requires neither expert routing nor additional gradient training. On LIBERO, TCR merges four $π_{0.5}$ specialists and achieves 77.83% success across 1,200 evaluation episodes, outperforming FeatCal, RegMean, and direct weight averaging by 9.50, 24.17, and 33.00 percentage points, respectively.
abstract_zh: 机器人基础模型可适配为面向不同任务的专家策略，但能力分散在多个策略中。现有模型合并方法难以在闭环执行中可靠保留这些能力：参数空间对齐只能间接反映行为，而回归方法可能无法保留校准数据未覆盖状态下的行为。本文提出轨迹校准回归（Trajectory-Calibrated Regression，TCR），一种利用执行轨迹、无需梯度训练的策略合并框架。TCR 从两个互补的时间尺度采集校准输入：专家执行轨迹的不同任务阶段，以及迭代生成动作时的中间状态。为补偿合并引起的表征偏移，TCR 通过已合并的网络块重新计算当前块的输入，再利用各专家在块内的计算构造模块输入，拟合合并权重以匹配专家的线性输出。TCR 使用不同的轨迹缓存进行两轮校准，并始终以冻结的专家策略为教师。合并后的策略保留原始推理计算图，无需专家路由或额外的梯度训练。在 LIBERO 上，TCR 将四个 π_{0.5} 专家策略合并为单一策略，在 1,200 个评估回合中取得 77.83% 的成功率，较 FeatCal、RegMean 和直接权重平均分别提高 9.50、24.17 和 33.00 个百分点。
key_points_zh: 双时间尺度校准同时覆盖任务执行的不同阶段和迭代动作生成的中间状态。
逐块合并时，先用已合并的前序块重算输入以补偿表征偏移，再回归匹配专家模块的线性输出。
两轮校准使用不同的轨迹缓存，并以冻结的专家策略为教师；最终保留原始推理计算图，无需专家路由或额外梯度训练。
在 LIBERO 的 1,200 个评估回合中，合并后的策略成功率为 77.83%，比表现最好的基线 FeatCal 高 9.50 个百分点。
